teleframe: Teleframe is a screen recorder for Windows 10 and 11. Drag a frame over any part of your screen, record in 16:9, 9:16 or any shape, and save an MP4 with sound. Free 7-day trial, then $9.99 once, no subscription, no watermark.

Teleframe puts a frame on your desktop. Drag it where you want it, size it to any shape and press REC. Only what's inside the frame goes into the video, and the recorder's own controls never appear in it. Try it free for 7 days.
Free for 7 days with every feature. Windows 10 and 11. One-time purchase.
No subscription and no account. After paying, your license key appears on screen and is emailed to you. One key works on up to 3 PCs.

How does the license key work?

After you buy, you get a key that starts with TELE-. In Teleframe, click the gear, choose LICENSE and paste it. One key works on up to 3 PCs. Activation needs the internet once, and after that Teleframe works offline.
